Name: Linus Seasonal Leaves
Description:
Hi, this mod changes the color of Linus's leaf clothes with each season and adds 4 festival outfits (Flower Dance, Luau, Spirits Eve, & Winterstar).


[b]Config options:
[/b]"SeasonalClothes": "On, Off"
[list]
[*] Enables or Disables the mod.
[/list]
"WinterIndoorOutdoorOutfits": "IndoorOutdoor,IndoorOnly,OutdoorOnly"
[list]
[*] ﻿Changes whether indoor or outdoor variants of the winter outfit are enabled.
[/list]
"FestivalOutfits": "True, False"
[list]
[*] ﻿Enables or Disables the festival outfits.
[/list]
"SpringFlower": "True, False"
[list]
[*]Enable to let Linus wear a Flower on his head in Spring.
[/list]
"FallYellow": "True, False"
[list]
[*]Enable to change the Fall outfit's color to yellow instead of red.
[/list]

[b]Credits:[/b]
This mod was inspired by Poltergeister's Seasonal Outfits Mod and uses sprites created by them with edits by me.
Original Sprites/Portraits by ConcernedApe were edited by me.

Downloads.Description: Unzip file and place in mods folder. Requires Content Patcher and SMAPI.
